ooe-y.rule: When the final is ย, อ disappears and ย takes its place with no ◌ิ: เ + ล + อ + ย → เลย.

iia.rule: The compound vowel /ia/ has three pieces: เ before, ◌ี above and ย after. With a final, all three stay and the final follows ย.

uuea.rule: The compound vowel /ɯa/ is เ before, ◌ื above and อ after. Unlike plain ◌ือ, this อ stays when a final is added.

taikhu.rule: ◌็ and a tone mark compete for the same spot above the consonant. With a tone mark, ◌็ is dropped and the vowel is still read as short.
